entries.en:
“As a nutritional therapist specialized in female hormones, I’m extremely careful about what I put into my body. Hormones are sensitive. Stress, toxins, poor-quality ingredients — they all add up. So I don’t just look at labels, I look at what something will do inside the body.

I choose Karmicare because I trust what’s in it — and what’s not. No unnecessary fillers, no hidden disruptors. Just clean, purposeful ingredients that support rather than burden the nervous system and hormonal balance. When you understand how delicate the female endocrine system can be, especially under chronic stress, quality isn’t optional.

And that’s also why I use it in my practice.

I work with women dealing with PMS, cycle issues, stress-related fatigue, estrogen dominance and adrenal dysregulation. I need products that are technically sound — bioavailable, well-formulated, and supportive of detox pathways and nervous system regulation.

Karmicare fits that standard.”

entries.en: Because your mouth doesn’t do the same job all day. Daytime is exposure — acids, sugars, coffee — so Awake protects, activates and brightens. Night is repair — saliva drops and your body regenerates — so Asleep soothes, rebalances and remineralises while you sleep.

De nacht draait om herstel — je speeksel neemt af en je lichaam regenereert — dus Asleep kalmeert, herstelt het evenwicht en remineraliseert terwijl je slaapt.

entries.en: How quickly will I notice a difference?

Mineral remineralisation takes time — most members feel the sensitivity shift in 2–4 weeks and see visible brightening in 4–6. The ritual shift happens faster: you notice the bookend effect within the first week — a morning moment that wakes you up, an evening moment that winds you down.
entries.nl: Minerale remineralisatie vraagt tijd — de meeste leden voelen hun gevoeligheid veranderen binnen 2–4 weken en zien hun tanden binnen 4–6 weken zichtbaar stralender worden. De verandering in je ritueel gaat sneller: binnen de eerste week merk je het boekensteuneffect — een ochtendmoment dat je wakker maakt, een avondmoment dat je tot rust brengt.
